sections.shortTitle: Provincial Assembly of N -W F P Salaries and Allowances of Members Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XV OF 1991
ACT XV OF 1991
PROVINCIAL
ASSEMBLY OF NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to
amend the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province (Salaries and
Allowances of Members) Act, 1974
[Gazette of N.
W.F.P. Extraordinary, 7th October, 1991]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/91/17179,
dated 7-10-1991.---The Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province
(Salaries and Allowances of Members) (Amendment) Bill 1991 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 30th
September, 1991 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 5th October, 1991, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Provincial Assembly of the
North-West Frontier Province (Salaries and Allowances of Members) (Amendment)
Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 10th June, 1991.

2. Amendment of section 4 of
